card.name: Digit 2 inside phone and ID numbers
card.fires_on: The single digit 2 (or occasionally 4) in the middle of a number string, mainly the poison help line number 1-800-222-1222, and also ISBN, DOI and rating numbers.

modes.label: Poison help line number
modes.description: The first 2 after 1-800- in the poison help phone number.
modes.example: Consider contacting the Poison Help line (1-800-<<2>>22-1222)

modes.label: Reference identifiers
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN or DOI code in a citation.

modes.label: Rating digits
modes.description: A repeated digit right after a star rating.
modes.example: Overall rating 4 out of 5<<4>> (3 ratings) Last updated 3

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a long number, especially the poison help line phone number.
